'''Max Rebo's Collected Classics: Dirge''' was a collection of songs by [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]], that were made available for purchase by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], to be sold during the [[Galactic Moon Festival]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].
